product_overview: POSTFORM is a curated international fashion resale storefront with a bold editorial shopping experience. Customers can browse products, save items locally, manage a cart and profile, and complete guest checkout through an email-based order handoff.
core_goals: Browse the product catalogue through the homepage, shop, and category pages
Find products using search, filters, sorting, and pagination
Inspect product details, variants, and supporting purchase information
Manage a cart and a local wishlist
Complete guest checkout with customer details, delivery address, and order email generation
Maintain a local customer profile with saved addresses
Administer products and store settings through a protected admin area

features.name: Product Catalogue Browsing
features.description: Users can explore featured products on the homepage, open the full shop catalogue, navigate by category, and reach product detail pages from product cards.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View featured products and category links -> Open the full catalogue or a category listing -> Select a product card -> See the product detail page
Navigate to /shop -> Browse the product grid -> Move through paginated results -> Select a product card -> See the product detail page
Navigate to /shop/t-shirts -> Browse products in a category -> Select a product card -> See the product detail page

features.name: Shop Filtering, Search, Sort and Pagination
features.description: Users can narrow catalogue results with keyword search, filters, sorting, and pagination controls.
user_flows: Navigate to /shop -> Enter a keyword in search -> Submit the search -> See filtered results
Navigate to /shop -> Open filters -> Select a brand -> Apply size, colour, condition, or price filters -> See narrowed results
Navigate to /shop -> Change the sort order -> See products reordered -> Use pagination controls to move between pages
Navigate to /shop/shirts -> Open filters -> Apply category-specific filters -> See matching results

features.name: Product Detail and Variant Selection
features.description: Users can review product imagery and information, inspect variants, choose quantity, and read supporting product details before purchasing.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/defaced-backprint-tee -> View the product gallery and details -> Open an image in the lightbox -> Close the lightbox
Navigate to /product/defaced-backprint-tee -> Select an available size -> Select a colour when available -> Adjust quantity -> Add the item to the cart
Navigate to /product/defaced-backprint-tee -> Attempt to select a sold-out size -> See that the size is disabled and unavailable
Navigate to /product/defaced-backprint-tee -> Read the size chart and shipping/returns notes -> Decide whether to purchase

features.name: Cart Management
features.description: Users can add items to the cart, review the order summary, adjust quantities, remove items, and continue to checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/defaced-backprint-tee -> Select a size -> Add the item to the cart -> Open /cart -> Review the cart summary -> Proceed to checkout
Navigate to /cart -> Increase or decrease an item quantity -> See subtotal, shipping, and total update
Navigate to /cart -> Remove an item -> See the cart update
Navigate to /cart -> Review cart contents -> Proceed to checkout

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Users can save products locally in a browser-based wishlist, review saved items, and move items toward purchase.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/defaced-backprint-tee -> Add the product to the wishlist -> Open /wishlist -> Review saved items
Navigate to /wishlist -> Remove an item -> See the wishlist update
Navigate to /wishlist -> Move a saved item to the cart -> Open the cart to continue purchasing

features.name: Guest Checkout via Email Handoff
features.description: Users can place an order as a guest by entering contact and delivery details, choosing a payment method, and generating a prefilled email for the store.
user_flows: Navigate to /checkout -> Fill in name, email, and phone -> Fill in the international delivery address -> Choose a payment method -> Add an optional note -> Submit the order -> See the order confirmation with a POSTFORM order ID and email instructions
Navigate to /checkout -> Review the order summary -> Submit the order -> See a prefilled email opened in the default email application
Navigate to /checkout -> Leave a required customer field empty -> Attempt to submit the form -> See validation errors and correct the input

features.name: Local Profile and Saved Addresses
features.description: Users can store personal details and addresses locally to prefill checkout on the same browser.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Edit name, email, and phone -> Save the profile -> Return to /checkout and see the details prefilled
Navigate to /profile -> Add a new address -> Set it as default -> Return to /checkout and see the default address prefilled
Navigate to /profile -> Edit or delete a saved address -> See the saved address list update
Navigate to /profile -> Clear local data -> See the profile and saved addresses removed

features.name: Legal Pages
features.description: Users can open and read the policy pages linked from the storefront navigation and footer.
user_flows: Navigate to /privacy -> Read the privacy policy sections
Navigate to /terms -> Read the terms and conditions
Navigate to /refund -> Read the return and refund policy
Open a legal page from the footer -> Read the policy content

features.name: Admin Login
features.description: Administrators can sign in with a password to access protected admin routes.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Enter the admin password -> Submit the form -> See the admin dashboard
Navigate to /admin/login -> Enter an incorrect password -> Submit the form -> See an error message
Navigate to /admin/login -> Sign in successfully -> Get redirected to the admin area

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Administrators can view, create, edit, feature, hide, and delete products, including variants, images, tags, and merchandising data.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/products -> View the products table -> Toggle featured or live status -> See the table update
Navigate to /admin/products/new -> Fill in product basics, pricing, variants, media, and tags -> Save the product -> See it appear in the product list
Navigate to /admin/products/[id]/edit -> Update product details -> Save changes -> See the updated product data
Navigate to /admin/products -> Select a product -> Delete the product after confirmation -> See it removed from the list

features.name: Admin Dashboard and Settings
features.description: Administrators can review store metrics and adjust shipping, currency, and order email settings that affect the storefront and checkout.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> View totals, stock warnings, and category coverage
Navigate to /admin/settings -> Change shipping mode or fee -> Change currency or order email recipient -> Save settings -> See the updated settings reflected on the storefront
Navigate to /admin/settings -> Review current store configuration -> Adjust values as needed -> Save the configuration

tech_stack: Next.js 16 App Router with React Server Components
Tailwind CSS v4 with custom Neo-Brutalist design tokens
Zustand for cart/wishlist/profile client state (localStorage persistence)
Prisma ORM with libsql driver adapter

routes.description: Storefront home — hero, featured products, category index, editorial blocks
Shop catalogue with search, category/brand/size/colour/condition/price filters, sort, pagination
Product detail — swipeable gallery with lightbox, variants, quantity, sticky mobile buy bar
Cart — line items with quantity steppers, order summary, checkout entry
Guest checkout — contact, international delivery address, payment method choice, note, email order handoff
Local customer profile and saved addresses (localStorage, prefills checkout)
Return and refund policy (video-proof requirement, 5-7 day refunds)
Admin product list with create/edit/delete and featured/active toggles
Admin store settings (shipping, currency, store email)

features.name: Mobile App-Like Navigation
features.description: Persistent sticky header with prominent search, horizontal scrolling category strip, and fixed 5-tab bottom navigation (Home/Shop/Saved/Profile/Cart) with cart badge and safe-area support on phones and tablets; desktop keeps conventional header navigation
user_interactions: See persistent search bar under the header on mobile and type a query
Tap category pills in the horizontally scrolling strip to filter the shop
Tap any of the five bottom navigation tabs and see the active state and cart badge
Open the hamburger drawer menu and navigate to categories or help pages

features.name: Product Browsing and Search
features.description: Shop catalogue with live search, filters (category, brand, size, colour, condition, price range), four sort orders, pagination, and empty states; mobile filters open as a bottom sheet
user_interactions: Type in the search bar and submit to see matching products
Open FILTER bottom sheet on mobile, pick filters, tap Show results
Choose a sort order and verify re-ordering
Page through results and clear all filters

features.name: Product Detail and Purchase
features.description: Product page with swipeable image gallery and fullscreen lightbox, variant selection (size/colour with stock-aware availability), quantity stepper, add-to-cart, buy-now, and sticky mobile purchase bar above the bottom navigation
user_interactions: Swipe the product gallery and tap an image to open the fullscreen viewer
Select size and colour variants (unavailable combinations disabled)
Change quantity with the stepper
Tap ADD TO CART or BUY NOW from the sticky mobile bar

features.name: Cart Management
features.description: Cart page with per-item quantity steppers bounded by stock, remove buttons, subtotal/shipping/total summary, and empty-cart state
user_interactions: Increase and decrease item quantities
Remove an item from the cart
See totals update and proceed to checkout

features.name: Guest Checkout with Email Handoff
features.description: No-account checkout collecting contact details, international delivery address, payment method (PayPal or Visa/prepaid card), and a customer note; submitting builds a mailto order email to the store
user_interactions: Fill name, email, and phone
Select country and fill an international address
Choose PayPal or Visa card payment
Add a note and place the order to reach the confirmation screen

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Save products for later from product cards and the product page; wishlist page lists saved items with add-to-cart
user_interactions: Tap the heart on a product card to save or unsave
Open the wishlist page and add a saved item to the cart

features.name: Local Customer Profile
features.description: Lightweight localStorage profile with saved addresses that prefill the checkout form
user_interactions: Enter personal details and save
Add a saved address
Start checkout and see saved details prefilled

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Password-protected admin with dashboard stats, product CRUD (images, variants, tags, featured/active toggles), and store settings editing
user_interactions: Sign in with the admin password
Create a product with images and variants
Edit and delete products, toggle featured/active
Update store settings

features.name: Loading and Error States
features.description: Skeleton loading screens for shop and product routes, branded storefront error boundary with retry, and toast notifications positioned clear of mobile fixed bars
user_interactions: Navigate to shop or product pages and see skeleton placeholders while data loads

known_limitations.issue: Checkout payment is an email handoff, not an online payment integration
known_limitations.impact: Orders arrive as mailto emails to the store; no payment provider SDK is wired yet

known_limitations.issue: Customer profile and cart live only in browser localStorage
known_limitations.impact: Clearing browser data loses the cart and saved addresses; by design for the no-account model

known_limitations.issue: Admin session has no rate limiting on login
